briefing.text: Hello Duty Engineer. Recommendation: NO GRITTING NEEDED on current forecast. Coldest route is R200 with a forecast road surface minimum of 7.2 C. Confidence is HIGH: the rules engine and the trained model agree on most routes. As always, you have the final say.

S1.name: Open-Meteo forecast API
S1.what: hourly air temp, dew point, precipitation, cloud, wind at 22 grid cells

S2.name: OpenStreetMap (Overpass), filtered to the council's designated routes
S2.what: trunk/primary/secondary roads in County Cavan with ref tags; routes built by grouping on ref. Priority 1 and 2 follow S7. N16 is excluded (salted by Leitrim County Council). Six R roads are not on the council plan (R179, R181, R195, R196, R394, R901) and are kept for analysis only.

S3.name: ERA5 / ERA5-Land via Open-Meteo archive
S3.what: 7 winters Oct 2018 - Mar 2025, used for backtest and model training

S4.name: Copernicus DEM via Open-Meteo elevation API
S4.what: route elevation sampled about every 1 km

S5.name: Winter Watch rules engine
S5.what: lapse-rate adjustment, road surface estimate, GO/MARGINAL/NO-GO thresholds (see thresholds), and the truck scheduler (ww/scheduler.py) that chains roads into runs for the 9-truck fleet

S7.name: Cavan County Council Winter Service Plan 2023/2024 (October 2023)
S7.what: PRIMARY DOCUMENT. Table 1: designated Priority 1 and 2 routes and levels of service. A7: Duty Engineer decision-making, Met Eireann forecasts, Vaisala Manager, two road weather stations on the N3 (Virginia, Butlersbridge), forecasting accurate to about 85% at best. A8: resources, one Machinery Yard with 9 trucks and 11 spreaders, 7 mini salters in the three Municipal Districts, 2,750 t salt storage (about 30 runs). A9: call-outs per winter 2007/08 to 2022/23, used to validate the backtest.
S7.policy: Priority 1 treated during all weather events. Priority 2 treated in normal winter service but may be interrupted in severe weather. Priority 1 treated to the exclusion of all others when resources are limited. Priority 3 only intermittent at Municipal District Engineers' discretion.

S8.name: Cavan County Council: Current Salting Routes and Winter Service Plan pages
S8.what: Public statements: Priority 1 is N3, N54, N55, N87; about 90 tonnes of salt covers about 500 km a night; Ice Cast alerts; salt does not guarantee safe speeds and frost after rain can undo treatment.

S9.name: Press reports of council statements
S9.what: Anglo Celt 01/02/2026 (645 km salted per night, 4 to 6 hour salting window, 'not physically possible to salt all routes'); Northern Sound 25/01/2022 (about 20% of network salted, no capacity to extend); Anglo Celt 12/12/2024 (councillor requests to extend routes, rain undoing salting).

S10.name: Other councils' Winter Service Plans, used for comparison only
S10.what: Monaghan 2025/26 (8 gritters, about 610 km, treatment time 2 to 5 hours), Mayo 2025/26 (Met Eireann about 80% forecast accuracy, 10% of regional roads and 95% of local roads not salted), Galway 2025/26 and Louth. Not used in any calculation.
